verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तस्य पुत्रास्त्रयः शिष्टा दृढाश्वो ज्येष्ठ उच्यते। चन्द्राश्वकपिलाश्वौ तु कुमारौ द्वौ कनीयसौ॥१॥
धौन्धुमारिर्दृढाश्वस्तु हर्यश्वस्तस्य चात्मजः। हर्यश्वस्य निकुम्भोऽभूत्क्षत्रधर्मरतः सदा॥२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: सगरान्तो दृढाश्वादिर्वंशो द्वादश ईरितः। विश्वामित्रकुटुम्बादिभरणं च त्रिशङ्कुतः॥१॥ तस्य धुन्धुमारस्य॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: संहताश्वो निकुम्भस्य पुत्रो रणविशारदः। अकृशाश्वः कृशाश्वश्च संहताश्वसुतौ नृप॥३॥
verses.english: The lineal descent of princes from धौन्धुमार, alias kuvalAshva, is as below: धौन्धुमार → दृढाश्व → हर्यश्व → निकुम्भ, a valiant kshatriya, → संहताश्व, who is an expert in warfare, and who begot two princes namely अकृशाश्व and कृशाश्व. This saMhatAshva's wife is dR^iShadvati, the daughter of himavAn, a famous lady in all the three worlds who begot best sons among whom प्रसेनजित् is one.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य हैमवती कन्या सतां माता दृषद्वती। विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु पुत्रश्चास्याः प्रसेनजित्॥४॥
verses.english: प्रसेनजित् married a husband-devout lady named गौरि, who later transfigured as the River बहुद, owing to a curse of her husband.

verses.sanskrit: लेभे प्रसेनजिद्भार्यां गौरीं नाम पतिव्रतां। अभिशप्ता तु सा भर्त्रा नदी वै बाहुदाभवत्॥५॥
verses.english: सत्यव्रत thus abducted someone's bride in some city... thinking this as an iniquitous action his father king त्रय्यारुण discarded him।
verses.bhavadeepa: तस्य संहताश्वस्य द्वारा हैमवती हिमवतः कन्या। अस्यां प्रसेनजित् जात इति शेषः॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः पुत्रो महानासीद्युवनाश्वो महीपतिः। मान्धाता युवनाश्वस्य त्रिलोकविजयी सुतः॥६॥
verses.english: Lady गौरि's son is king युवनाश्व, अन्द् yuvanAshva's son is मान्धात, the exalted one in three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चैत्ररथी भार्या शशबिन्दोः सुताभवत्। साध्वी बिन्दुमती नाम रूपेणासदृशी भुवि॥७॥
verses.english: मान्धात begot two sons through this lady चैत्ररथि; one is the righteous prince पुरुकुत्स, while the other is high-minded मुचुकुन्द।

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रता च ज्येष्ठा च भ्रातॄणामयुतस्य सा। तस्यामुत्पादयामास मान्धाता द्वौ सुतौ नृप॥८॥
verses.english: मान्धात begot two sons through this lady चैत्ररथि; one is the righteous prince पुरुकुत्स, while the other is high-minded मुचुकुन्द।

verses.sanskrit: पुरुकुत्सं तु धर्मज्ञं मुचुकुन्दं च धार्मिकम्। पुरुकुत्ससुतस्त्वासीत्त्रसद्दस्युर्महीपतिः॥९॥
verses.english: At one time, this mighty prince सत्यव्रत abducted a bride who is about to be married to someone, duly desecrating holy chants of marriage. This he has done owing to his reckless behaviour, lust, fascination, and owing to adventurism and spoilt bringing up.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायामथोत्पन्नः सम्भूतस्तस्य चात्मजः। सम्भूतस्य तु दायादः सुधन्वा नाम पार्थिवः॥१०॥
verses.english: सत्यव्रत thus abducted someone's bride in some city... thinking this as an iniquitous action his father king त्रय्यारुण discarded him।

verses.sanskrit: सुधन्वनः सुतश्चासीत्त्रिधन्वा रिपुमर्दनः। राज्ञस्त्रिधन्वनस्त्वासीद्विद्वांस्त्रय्यारुणः सुतः॥११॥
verses.english: When trayyAruNa angrily chided satyavrata many times saying, 'what you have done is disreputable... get out of my sight...' then satyavrata repeatedly asked his father, ' discarded by you... where shall I go...'

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सत्यव्रतो नाम कुमारोऽभून्महाबलः। पाणिग्रहणमन्त्राणां विघ्नं चक्रे सुदुर्मतिः॥१२॥
verses.english: Then trayyAruNa said to satyavrata, 'go and live with the eaters of dog-meat... I dont want to be called a father of a son who brings discredit to family...'

verses.sanskrit: येन भार्याहृता पूर्वं क्रितोद्वाहा परस्य वै। बाल्यात्कामाच्च मोहाच्च संहर्षाच्चापलेन च॥१३॥
verses.english: When he is said so, satyavrata exited from there according to his father's order. The godly sage vasiShTha, their family high priest did not even persuade him to stay back.
verses.bhavadeepa: पाणीति। मन्त्राणां नावेहि संवहावहै सह रेतो दधावहै पुंसे पुत्राय वेत्तवै इत्याद्यर्थानां विघ्नं प्रतिबन्धं चक्रे॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: जहार कन्यां कामात्सः कस्यचित्पुरवासिनः। अधर्मशङ्कुना तेन राजा त्रैय्यारुणोऽत्यजत्॥१४॥
verses.english: Then satyavrata had gone and lived with lowliest people. But his father trayyAruNa could not bear the plight of his son satyavrata, and on the pretext of going for hunting, he went to forest to fetch back his son. Because of this breach by the king in punishing a wrongdoer, indra withheld rain in that kingdom for twelve years...
verses.bhavadeepa: परस्परेण "पूर्वं कृतोद्वाहा ऊढा कन्या स्वभार्या कृतेत्यन्वयः। "सखा सप्तपदी भव” इत्यन्तिममन्त्रान्ते भार्यात्वमुत्पद्यते न ततः प्राक् अतस्तां प्रागेव जहार संहर्षादभिनिवशात्॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: अपध्वंसेति बहुशो वदन्क्रोधसमन्वितः। पितरं सोऽब्रवित्त्यक्तः क्व गच्छामीति वै मुहुः॥१५॥
verses.english: When trayyAruNa angrily chided satyavrata many times saying, 'what you have done is disreputable... get out of my sight...' then satyavrata repeatedly asked his father, ' discarded by you... where shall I go...'

verses.sanskrit: पिता त्वेनमथोवाच श्वपाकैः सह वर्तय। नाहं पुत्रेण पुत्रार्थी त्वयाद्य कुलपांसन॥१६॥
verses.english: Then trayyAruNa said to satyavrata, 'go and live with the eaters of dog-meat... I dont want to be called a father of a son who brings discredit to family...'

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः स निराक्रामन्नगराद्वचनात्पितुः। न च तं वारयामास वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः॥१७॥
verses.english: When he is said so, satyavrata exited from there according to his father's order. The godly sage vasiShTha, their family high priest did not even persuade him to stay back.

verses.sanskrit: स तु सत्यव्रतस्तात श्वपाकावसथान्तिके। पित्रा त्यक्तोऽवसद्धीरः पिता तस्य वनं ययौ॥१८॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the twelfth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the legends of gAlava and satyavrata.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्मिंस्तु विषये नावर्षत्पाकशासनः। समा द्वादश राजेन्द्र तेनाधर्मेण वै तदा॥१९॥
दारांस्तु तस्य विषये विश्वामित्रो महातपाः। संन्यस्य सागरानूपे चचार विपुलं तपः॥२०॥
verses.bhavadeepa: पाकशासन इन्द्रः तेनाधर्मेण विप्रविवाहविघ्नजेन पितृक्षोभेण न तु राज्ञः प्रजात्यागेन प्रव्रजतो विरक्तस्य दोषाभावात् तस्मिन्नपरितोषो यः पितुरासीदित्यादिशेषग्रन्थाच्च॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पत्नी गले बद्ध्वा मध्यमं पुत्रमौरसम्। शेषस्य भरणार्थाय व्यक्रीणाद्गोशतेन वै॥२१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: तस्य त्रिशंकोर्विषये देशे संन्यस्य न्यासरूपेण स्थापयित्वा॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: तं तु बद्धं गले दृष्ट्वा विक्रीयन्तं नृपात्मजः। महर्षिपुत्रं धर्मात्मा मोक्षयामास भारत॥२२॥
verses.english: Commiserative with the plight of boy thus tied with a rope around neck and being sold like an animal, satyavrata, the prince-in-exile, stopped selling him, got him released from headstall, and started to give sustenance for that family, as satyavrata is a not only a mighty man but also a noble minded person. This he has done just to keep vishvAmitra feel good and satisfied about the safe and secure position of his family while he remained in his own pursuit.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यव्रतो महाबाहुर्भरणं तस्य चाकरोत्। विश्वामित्रस्य तुष्ट्यर्थमनुकम्पार्थमेव च॥२३॥
सोऽभवद्गालवो नाम गलबन्धान्महातपाः। महर्षिः कौशिकस्तात तेन वीरेण मोक्षितः॥२४॥
verses.english: Because a headstall is tied around his neck that boy derived the name of गालव, where गल is neck, throat... and this boy, thus released by valiant satyavrata, later became the augmenter of the dynasty of great-sage kaushika, namely vishvAmitra.
